item.title: About Me
item.description:
Who Am I?

I am a penetester who tries to understand how things work and figure out how to make them better. Currently, my focus revolves mostly around Active Directory. I’m working towards a Diploma (who knows, maybe a BSc!) in Cybersecurity, and I’ve picked up a few industry certifications along the way, including OSWA, OSCP, CRTP, and CAPE.

I’ve only been in this field since early 2024, so expect a good amount of inaccuracies in my posts. That said, I’m always open to discussion and critical feedback if you spot something worth correcting or exploring further.
